data.name: low
text:
mud_loss (low)
page: MOR-008_DDR_2021-10-10.pdf#p1
cause: Total losses encountered in Barail, no returns to surface for 1.4 hrs.
remedy: Pumped cement plug to seal loss zone, waited on cement, tested integrity before resuming.
NPT: 1.41 h

torque_spike (low)
page: MOR-008_DDR_2021-10-12.pdf#p1
cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Basement, ROP dropped to near zero.
remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
NPT: 2.14 h

data.name: high
text:
overpressure (high)
page: MOR-008_DDR_2021-10-11.pdf#p1
cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Barail, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.
NPT: 10.56 h

kick (high)
page: MOR-008_DDR_2021-10-11.pdf#p1
cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 93 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.
NPT: 8.58 h

data.name: medium
text:
mud_loss (medium)
page: MOR-008_DDR_2021-10-11.pdf#p1
cause: Lost circulation 61 bbl/hr while drilling Sylhet sand, partial returns only.
remedy: Pumped 110 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.
NPT: 3.12 h

data.name: medium
text:
cementing_issue (medium)
page: MOR-002_DDR_2010-05-18.pdf#p1
cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Namsang.
remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.
NPT: 2.91 h

wellbore_instability (medium)
page: MOR-002_DDR_2010-05-18.pdf#p1
cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Namsang, oversized cuttings at surface.
remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.
NPT: 4.19 h

wellbore_instability (medium)
page: MOR-002_DDR_2010-05-18.pdf#p1
cause: Hole instability / cavings on surface while drilling Namsang, tight hole on connections.
remedy: Increased mud weight and viscosity, short-tripped to condition hole.
NPT: 3.92 h

text:
stuck_pipe (high)
page: MOR-002_DDR_2010-05-19.pdf#p1
cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.
NPT: 6.09 h

fishing_operation (high)
page: MOR-002_DDR_2010-05-19.pdf#p1
cause: Following stuck pipe in Girujan, back-off performed, fish left in hole.
remedy: Ran fishing BHA, latched fish with overshot, recovered string to surface.
NPT: 11.46 h

overpressure (high)
page: MOR-002_DDR_2010-05-22.pdf#p1
cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
remedy: Raised mud weight in 97-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.
NPT: 7.17 h
